name: argument-parser-positive-test-e41e5b8a0a/char-v
spec_references: Module-level declarations: "Supports [`required-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#required-params), [`defaultable-params`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#defaultable-params), [`included-record-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#included-record-param) and [`rest-param`](https://ballerina.io/spec/lang/master/#rest-param) in the signature"
Subset restrictions / Import declarations: "Only following lang libraries with given methods/types are supported"; `ballerina/lang.string` lists `Char`.
reason: The signature and string:Char type are supported, but the asserted behavior requires the external command-line argument parser to convert @args ["A"] into a string:Char main parameter and execute main. Subset 10 does not cover this execution protocol; function signature support does not establish it.
unsupported_constructs: Command-line argument binding/conversion to the string:Char parameter of main.
test_design_notes: @args ["A"] and @output A assert successful command-line parameter binding and execution. io:println is output instrumentation, not the unsupported feature.
